sources.entry: Magic Switch - Switch Magic Keyboard, Mouse, and Trackpad between multiple Macs.

summary.name: Magic Switch
summary.one_liner: Magic Switch is a Mac menu bar app that moves an Apple Magic Keyboard and Magic Mouse between multiple Macs with one click.
use_cases: Using one Magic Keyboard and Mouse with several Macs
Switching Apple peripherals between a desktop and laptop
Avoiding manual Bluetooth unpairing and repairing
Quickly changing which Mac controls shared Apple input devices
summary.what_it_does: Magic Switch runs from the top menu bar of a Mac. It switches Apple Magic Keyboard and Magic Mouse connections between multiple Mac devices with a single click. According to the page, it automatically unpairs the devices from one machine and pairs them with another, so the user does not have to do this manually. The page also says it works with Magic Trackpad in the listing, though the page text itself names only the keyboard and mouse.
notable: One-click switching of Magic Keyboard and Magic Mouse between Macs
Automatic unpairing and pairing over Bluetooth
Lives in the macOS top menu bar
caveats: Pricing and availability details are not stated on the page
Only works with Apple Magic peripherals and Macs, per the page's description
